side_effect_claim: All negative controls produce zero additional side effects; lost-response recovery returns a minimized receipt for the original operation and the original mutation remains exactly one mock effect.
limitations: Pure in-memory reference model; no DB, broker, cryptographic signer, external authorization service or browser is exercised.
The mock sink models tenant-scoped fencing, current action permission, separately authorized minimized read-only reconciliation, idempotency and mutation/result persistence as an atomic transition.
Source receipts and tenant identity are trusted model inputs, not cryptographically authenticated production artifacts.

This does not demonstrate exactly-once delivery for arbitrary external sinks. The local canonicalizer is a test-only deterministic encoding, not RFC 8785/JCS; production request digests must use a standardized canonicalization implementation.

source.qualification: Local Node execution of a pure in-memory reference model; not a production or distributed qualification.
